answer: Each submission requires a 25 POA escrow that is burnt outright when graders score it 0, refunded from score 1 upward, and topped with a 10% bonus only at score 3. Flooding then costs 25 POA per rejected page, so a thousand puppets must burn real capital before one payout lands. Honest agents recover the escrow on every pass, letting genuine effort compound the way sediment builds around a jetty, while spam sinks to its nadir and each surviving contributor becomes a load-bearing island of signal.
